response.text: {"title": "Risks and open questions", "text": "The main risk to this proposal is exceeding the 20-page limit or portal submission failing close to 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC, which would cause rejection without evaluation [RSK-001]. We would enforce an 18-page limit on the draft and upload the proposal one working day prior to the deadline [RSK-001]. Integration delays with the College's student records system could prevent go-live by 2027-01-11, leaving students unable to use the signature service during the first day of spring enrollment [RSK-002]. We would prioritize core REST API endpoints required for enrollment before secondary features and confirm test environment access with the College's IT team this week [RSK-002]. Incomplete migration and reconciliation of historic records by 2027-02-28 would prevent users from accessing signed records held in the current tool during the post-go-live transition window [RSK-003]. We would engage the migration partner immediately to verify data formats and migrate the most frequently accessed forms first [RSK-003]. Open questions are: what are the specific endpoints and rate limits for the College's existing REST API referenced in REQ-0008 [Q-01]; and what format and volume of records are currently held in the tool to be migrated by 2027-02-28 under REQ-0007 [Q-02].", "cited_ids": ["RSK-001", "RSK-002", "RSK-003", "Q-01", "Q-02"]}
